status: Complete. Grips, muzzles, barrels, ergos, magazines and ammo match the site on every handling, velocity and sway operand. Sights carry two category-wide effects the site omits (candidates).
question: Which handling, velocity and sway effects (ADS time, draw/deploy, sprint recovery, ADS move speed, reload, sway, muzzle velocity) does a site choice select in source that the site does not model? Reverse direction of the earlier site-to-source audits; L60 covered recoil and spread.
method: Six extract-only workers listed every non-neutral WME imported by each choice's WPM package and every GS-bound GID_* modifier. Claude joined them with join_l62.py against effective site values (grips/lasers/lights frostyModifiers, muzzles/ergos weaponOverrides, barrel *ByWeapon maps, WEAPON_MAG mags, ammo effectOverrides), testing both signs per field, and listed non-neutral site values with no source row.

inference: Category-wide optic effects remove the site's stated reason for omitting sights (a category cannot pick one source optic). Under the site's resolver, var_high and thermal would lower the ADS move index by one (AK205 0.67 -> 0.60) and Mobility by 2 (weight 2 on the move index). Iron sights would make every optic show +50% weapon sway against the iron-sight default.
